scrutiny.definition_en: careful and detailed examination of something
scrutiny.example_en: The new system came under scrutiny after several security problems were reported.
scrutiny.example_zh: 在多起資安問題被通報後，這套新系統受到密切檢視。

anonymization.definition_en: the process of removing identifying information from data so it cannot easily be linked to a person
anonymization.example_en: The company uses anonymization to reduce privacy risks when analyzing customer data.
anonymization.example_zh: 該公司透過匿名化處理，在分析客戶資料時降低隱私風險。

breach.definition_en: an act of breaking a rule, law, agreement, or duty
breach.example_en: The regulator investigated whether the company had committed a breach of the rules.
breach.example_zh: 監管機構調查該公司是否有違反規定的行為。

sanction.definition_en: a penalty imposed for breaking a rule or law
sanction.example_en: The organization could face a financial sanction if the violation is confirmed.
sanction.example_zh: 如果違規行為獲得確認，該組織可能面臨財務處罰。

appeal.definition_en: to formally ask for a legal or official decision to be reviewed and changed
appeal.example_en: The company plans to appeal the decision after reviewing the written ruling.
appeal.example_zh: 該公司計畫在審閱書面裁決後提出上訴。

foothold.definition_en: a secure starting position from which further progress can be made
foothold.zh: 立足點；初步穩固的地位
foothold.example_en: The partnership gave the company a foothold in a rapidly growing market.
foothold.example_zh: 這項合作讓該公司在快速成長的市場中取得立足點。

emerging.definition_en: beginning to develop, grow, or become important
emerging.example_en: The company is investing heavily in emerging technologies.
emerging.example_zh: 該公司正大力投資新興科技。

roadmap.definition_en: a plan that shows the stages or direction for future development
roadmap.example_en: The team created a product roadmap for the next three years.
roadmap.example_zh: 團隊制定了未來三年的產品發展藍圖。

trade-off.definition_en: a situation in which gaining one benefit requires giving up another
trade-off.example_en: Engineers often face a trade-off between performance and energy consumption.
trade-off.example_zh: 工程師經常需要在效能與能源消耗之間做出取捨。

guardrail.definition_en: a rule, limit, or safeguard designed to prevent harmful or unwanted outcomes
guardrail.example_en: The company added new guardrails to reduce the risk of unsafe AI behavior.
guardrail.example_zh: 該公司加入新的防護機制，以降低 AI 出現不安全行為的風險。

fidelity.definition_en: the degree to which something accurately represents or reproduces the original or intended result
fidelity.example_en: The simulation needs a high level of fidelity before engineers can rely on its results.
fidelity.example_zh: 模擬必須具有高度精確度，工程師才能信賴其結果。

handover.definition_en: the process of transferring responsibility, control, or duties from one person or group to another
handover.example_en: The two teams scheduled a short handover before the new crew took responsibility.
handover.example_zh: 兩個團隊安排了短暫的交接，之後由新團隊接手負責。

resilience.definition_en: the ability to recover from difficulties and continue functioning or making progress
resilience.example_en: The team showed remarkable resilience after the unexpected setback.
resilience.example_zh: 團隊在遭遇意外挫折後展現了非凡的韌性。

autonomous.definition_en: able to operate or make decisions independently without direct human control
autonomous.example_en: The company is testing autonomous systems that can complete routine tasks with limited supervision.
autonomous.example_zh: 該公司正在測試能在有限監督下完成例行任務的自主系統。

sandboxing.definition_en: a computing technique that keeps software in a separated environment
sandboxing.zh: 沙盒機制；隔離執行技術
sandboxing.example_en: The operating system uses sandboxing to keep applications separated from one another.
sandboxing.example_zh: 作業系統使用沙盒機制，讓各個應用程式彼此隔離。

outlook.definition_en: an expectation or forecast about what is likely to happen in the future
outlook.example_en: The company raised its revenue outlook after demand improved.
outlook.example_zh: 需求改善後，公司上調了營收展望。

milestone.definition_en: an important stage or achievement in the development of something
milestone.example_en: Reaching one million users was an important milestone for the company.
milestone.example_zh: 達到一百萬名使用者是該公司的一個重要里程碑。

reliance.definition_en: the state of depending on someone or something
reliance.example_en: The manufacturer is trying to reduce its reliance on a single supplier.
reliance.example_zh: 這家製造商正試圖降低對單一供應商的依賴。

inventive.definition_en: showing creativity in producing new ideas, designs, or methods
inventive.zh: 富有創意的；有獨創性的
inventive.example_en: The engineers proposed an inventive solution to reduce waste.
inventive.example_zh: 工程師提出一個富有創意的方案，以減少浪費。

blend.definition_en: to combine different things so that they work together as a whole
blend.example_en: The training program blends online lessons with hands-on practice.
blend.example_zh: 這項訓練課程將線上教學與實作練習結合。

reimagine.definition_en: to think about or present something in a new and different way
reimagine.zh: 重新構想；以新方式詮釋
reimagine.example_en: The design team reimagined the packaging to make it easier to recycle.
reimagine.example_zh: 設計團隊重新構想包裝方式，使其更容易回收。
